events.title: Trump–Xi White House summit; US–China trade truce extended to Jan 10
events.why_it_matters: Bessent confirmed a 2-month truce extension to Jan 10 as Xi arrived, removing the Nov 10 cliff and de-risking the single biggest tail for global equities.
events.what_to_watch: Whether signed purchase contracts, rare-earth flow resumption and AI-guardrail language follow the handshake, or whether Taiwan arms and chip controls re-escalate after Xi leaves.

events.title: US–Iran UNGA talks on reopening Hormuz; 'very productive' 3-hour contact
events.why_it_matters: First real diplomatic path to collapsing the Hormuz war premium; Iran denies dropping preconditions, so oil stays headline-driven.
events.what_to_watch: Whether a follow-up round is scheduled and whether Iran's blockade-lift/unfreeze-assets conditions soften.

events.title: Hormuz tanker war still live; Brent ~$98–100, strait effectively closed to commercial shipping
events.why_it_matters: Physical flows remain a fraction of pre-war norms (1 ship transited Sept 20 vs ~85/day normal), keeping the war premium in G3 inflation and the Warsh extra-hike path.
events.what_to_watch: Daily transit counts and any naval-escort convoy expansion; a single new tanker strike re-spikes Brent.

events.title: Iranian President Pezeshkian defiant UNGA address
events.why_it_matters: Defiant rhetoric after Trump's 'deal or annihilate' speech keeps the diplomatic window open but fragile, so oil can reprice intra-day on any Trump–Iran sideline.
events.what_to_watch: Any readout of a Trump–Pezeshkian or Witkoff–Araghchi follow-up before UNGA ends.

events.title: US–China trade truce extension to Jan 10 (Bessent announcement)
events.why_it_matters: Removes the Nov 10 tariff-cliff tail risk and buys six weeks of negotiation runway, a clear risk-on catalyst for trade-sensitive cyclicals and semis.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the extension is formalized in a signed joint statement and whether tariff-rate cuts (the '30-by-30' idea) are actually delivered.

events.title: Graham Russia/Iran sanctions law — up to 100% secondary tariffs on energy buyers
events.why_it_matters: Congress cleared a bill enabling up to 100% tariffs on major buyers of Russian energy (India, China), a live escalation channel into EM trade and crude flows.
events.what_to_watch: Whether Trump actually invokes the secondary tariffs and how India/China retaliate; India has warned it could hit ties.

events.title: FY2027 government funding deadline / shutdown risk
events.why_it_matters: FY2026 funding expires Sept 30; a Senate-passed CR funds government through Dec 11, but a House-Senate mismatch could still trigger an Oct 1 shutdown into the midterms.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the House takes up the Senate's 90-6 bipartisan CR before midnight Sept 30.

events.title: US Section 338 import bans on selected Canadian goods take effect
events.why_it_matters: Sept 8 proclamations convert parts of the 50% Canada tit-for-tat into outright bans on specified beer/wine/spirits, some dairy/whey and large motorcycles at 12:01 a.m. ET Sept 29.
events.what_to_watch: Canadian retaliation and any USMCA/WTO challenge; watch beverage and motorcycle importers.

events.title: IEEPA tariff litigation / refunds after Supreme Court ruling
events.why_it_matters: Post-Supreme-Court tariff ruling, the administration pivoted to Section 338/1930-law authority and is appealing CIT refund orders, keeping tariff legal risk and refund liability live.
events.what_to_watch: Any new CIT/SCOTUS action on IEEPA refunds and whether refunds hit fiscal revenue assumptions.

events.title: Google ad-tech antitrust remedy order (behavioral, no AdX divestiture)
events.why_it_matters: Court ordered behavioral remedies and let Google keep AdX, a relief for Alphabet and a negative read-through for ad-tech plaintiffs/competitors.
events.what_to_watch: Compliance terms and any appeal by DOJ or states.

events.title: August PCE / personal income + Q2 GDP third estimate
events.why_it_matters: First post-Warsh inflation print; consensus clusters around core PCE +0.25–0.28% m/m and ~3.3–3.4% y/y, with NIPA annual revisions that could shave y/y and reprice the extra 2026 hike.
events.what_to_watch: Core PCE m/m and the annual-update revision; a hot print locks in the Oct 28 hike.

events.title: October 2 nonfarm payrolls (September jobs report)
events.why_it_matters: August payrolls came in at +162k, raising hike expectations; a strong September print cements the Oct 28 hike, a weak one revives the 'Warsh over-tightening' debate.
events.what_to_watch: Headline NFP, unemployment rate and average hourly earnings; watch for shutdown-related data delays.

events.title: August JOLTS job openings
events.why_it_matters: Opens labor week into NFP; consensus ~7.2m openings after July's ~7.3m, a gauge of how much tightness the Warsh Fed still sees.
events.what_to_watch: Quits rate and layoffs for signs of labor-market cooling.

events.title: FOMC October 28 meeting — market pricing ~54% for a 25bp hike
events.why_it_matters: Warsh's first hike (Sept, 12-0) plus a hawkish dot plot has futures pricing ~4.2% by December; the Oct 28 decision is the next regime-setting event just outside this window.
events.what_to_watch: Whether PCE/NFP between now and then shift the ~54% hike odds.

events.title: August new-home sales
events.why_it_matters: Confirms whether the housing crack (existing sales 3.98m, starts 1.275m) is spreading into new-home demand after the Warsh hike.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the print extends the decline seen in regional BIA data.

events.title: BoJ 1.25% policy rate effective; 10y JGB at three-decade high
events.why_it_matters: Highest BoJ rate in 31 years (7-2 vote Sept 18) starts transmitting into JGB/yen funding just as G3 tightening is otherwise done; JGB yields at 3% risk global duration spillover.
events.what_to_watch: Yen level and any MoF intervention; JGB 10y yield path.

events.title: Japan Takaichi fiscal stimulus / debt-jitter debate
events.why_it_matters: Debt jitters are forcing Takaichi to rethink stimulus; FY2027 tax reform approved with a food tax cut from April, keeping JGB supply and yen risk in focus.
events.what_to_watch: Size and funding of any new stimulus package and its effect on JGB yields.

events.title: Eurozone September flash HICP
events.why_it_matters: August HICP hit 3.2–3.3% (highest since 2023) on energy; the ECB hiked to 2.50% in September and flagged above-target inflation for a while, so a hot flash print keeps ECB hike risk alive.
events.what_to_watch: Core HICP and energy contribution; any ECB speakers signaling a further hike.

events.title: China NBS September PMIs
events.why_it_matters: Official manufacturing/non-manufacturing stayed sub-50 in August (49.8/49.0); a third contraction month into the Trump–Xi visit pressures Beijing for stimulus the PBoC has refused via LPR.
events.what_to_watch: New-orders sub-index and whether Beijing signals fresh fiscal/monetary support.

events.title: China Golden Week / National Day holiday consumption
events.why_it_matters: Up to 13 days off could push tourism to new highs, a key read on Chinese consumer health and a swing factor for global luxury/travel names.
events.what_to_watch: Travel volumes, box-office and duty-free sales versus 2025.

events.title: Micron fiscal Q4 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Only mega-semiconductor bellwether in this window; stock up ~275% YTD, HBM4 ramp and tight DRAM supply vs China export-control and Trump–Xi AI-guardrail risk.
events.what_to_watch: HBM4 guidance, DRAM pricing and any China revenue commentary.

events.title: Costco Q4 FY2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Largest S&P 500 print this week and a high-frequency read on US traffic/mix with gasoline and food inflation still sticky from Hormuz.
events.what_to_watch: Membership growth, traffic and margin commentary; DoorDash launch read-through.

events.title: Nike Q1 FY2027 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Sales expected to drop ~3.2% on China and EMEA weakness; stock at a fresh 52-week low, a key read on global consumer discretionary and China demand.
events.what_to_watch: China revenue, gross margin and FY guidance.

events.title: Carnival Q3 2026 earnings
events.why_it_matters: Stock near yearly low into the print; a read on discretionary travel demand with fuel costs elevated from Hormuz.
events.what_to_watch: Booking curve, onboard spend and fuel-cost guidance.

events.title: Oura (~$2.1–2.2bn) IPO pricing
events.why_it_matters: Smart-ring maker targeting ~$15.6bn valuation is the marquee fall-listing demand test; mostly a secondary-shareholder payday, so a weak print signals IPO-window fatigue.
events.what_to_watch: Final pricing vs range and first-day pop; read-through to other pending consumer-tech IPOs.

events.title: SpaceX (SPCX) staggered lockup tranche
events.why_it_matters: Continued staggered post-IPO unlocks add supply into a still-thin mega-IPO float; prior unlocks saw both selloffs and relief rallies.
events.what_to_watch: Size of the next tranche and whether insiders sell into strength.

events.title: Boeing SPEEA engineers contract vote / strike risk
events.why_it_matters: Union endorsed Boeing's second offer and voting begins Thursday; a rejection could freeze 777X work and add to Boeing's delivery/execution risk.
events.what_to_watch: Vote result and whether a strike is called.

events.title: OPEC+ output policy — October quotas held, focus shifts to 2027
events.why_it_matters: OPEC+ kept October quotas unchanged amid the Hormuz disruption, leaving the market to price geopolitical supply risk rather than cartel policy.
events.what_to_watch: Any emergency meeting or 2027 quota guidance as Hormuz persists.

events.title: South Korea record chip exports; KOSPI reclaims 7,000
events.why_it_matters: Record AI-chip exports lifted KOSPI above 7,000 and Samsung shares, but the Bank of Korea flagged the AI-chip trade as a financial-stability risk and a stronger won may soften Samsung/SK Hynix earnings.
events.what_to_watch: October 1 Korean trade data and won strength vs chip earnings translation.

events.title: US midterm elections — market positioning into November
events.why_it_matters: With less than six weeks to the midterms and cost-of-living the dominant issue, policy-gridlock and sector-rotation positioning is already seeping into equities.
events.what_to_watch: Polling shifts on cost of living and any late-cycle fiscal/tariff moves timed to the election.

events.title: India–US tariff standoff over Russian oil purchases
events.why_it_matters: India warned new US tariffs over Russian oil could hit ties and vowed to protect energy security; a 100% tariff threat is a live EM trade and crude-flow risk.
events.what_to_watch: Whether the administration imposes the secondary tariffs and India's countermeasures.

events.title: Atlantic hurricane season — record-quiet, but Super El Niño brewing
events.why_it_matters: A historically quiet Atlantic season (no hurricanes yet) has kept storm-risk premia low, but Tropical Storm Fay formed Sept 20 and forecasters watch waters near the US.
events.what_to_watch: Any named storm tracking toward the Gulf/Atlantic coast and its effect on energy/insurance.

events.title: SEMICON West 2026 / India chip-event investment wave
events.why_it_matters: Applied Materials pledged $5bn India investment as Modi's flagship chip event kicked off; SEMICON West showcased advanced inspection, reinforcing the AI-capex narrative.
